notes: The Honda Super-ONE is Honda's first BEV for the Australian market, a Kei-class city car sold initially via an Expression of Interest (EOI)/pre-order process rather than a standard dealer order book; treated as 'current' since pricing and specs are confirmed and pre-orders are open. Range-cycle conflict: Honda's own EOI page states 'up to 253km range (NEDC)' while GoAuto's August 2026 pricing-confirmation article (citing Honda's own final pricing announcement) states a WLTP range of 206km for the same car - these are not the same test cycle and are recorded separately rather than merged; the more recent WLTP 206km figure accompanying final pricing is used as the primary rangeKm/rangeCycle, with the NEDC 253km figure noted as a low-confidence alternate in fieldSources. Power rating is dual-mode: 47kW standard, up to 70kW/162Nm in 'BOOST Mode' (a temporary boost via a simulated 7-speed transmission) - powerKw records the peak 70kW boost figure per common EV convention, with the 47kW continuous rating flagged as an alternate in notes.

fieldSources.powerKw: Standard/continuous output is 47kW; 70kW/162Nm applies only in temporary 'BOOST Mode'
